```plato

    //==
    // Quad-grid face indices — the shared routine behind everything grid-shaped:
    // parametric-surface tessellation, height fields, surfaces of revolution, and
    // the UV grids of the solids (see `library Solids` in solids.library.plato).
    //
    // A grid of nCols x nRows vertices is stored row-major, so grid vertex
    // (col, row) has linear index row * nCols + col. Each cell contributes one
    // quad. Wrap-around is expressed by taking the NEIGHBOUR coordinate modulo
    // the corresponding count, so a closed direction simply reuses column/row 0
    // rather than needing a duplicated seam ring of vertices.
    //
    // The four corner indices of one quad face in a regular grid, as a `QuadFace`
    // whose four fields are `VertexIndex` — these ARE cross-array references into a position
    // array, exactly the case README.md reserves the typed index types for, and it
    // makes the result feed `QuadMesh3D.Faces` directly with no conversion.

    // The four vertex indices of the quad cell whose low corner is grid vertex
    // (col, row), wound counter-clockwise:
    //
    //     d -- c
    //     |    |
    //     a -- b
    //
    // where a == (col, row), b == (col+1, row), c == (col+1, row+1) and
    // d == (col, row+1). The +1 neighbours wrap via `%`, so this function alone
    // always produces a closed cell; openness is expressed by the CALLER stopping
    // one short (see AllQuadFaceIndices). Preconditions: nCols > 0, nRows > 0, and
    // 0 <= col < nCols, 0 <= row < nRows.
    QuadFaceIndices(col: Integer, row: Integer, nCols: Integer, nRows: Integer): QuadFace
    {
        var a = (row * nCols) + col;
        var b = (row * nCols) + ((col + 1) % nCols);
        var c = (((row + 1) % nRows) * nCols) + ((col + 1) % nCols);
        var d = (((row + 1) % nRows) * nCols) + col;
        return (VertexIndex(a), VertexIndex(b), VertexIndex(c), VertexIndex(d));
    }
```
